entries.dc0208d486e83ec2: The group purpose is 'Creating a way of living for the next generation in which people and nature thrive together.' Its five-year medium-term management plan covering the fiscal years ended March 2027 through March 2031 takes as its theme 'Dynamic Capability 2.0: Strengthening corporate transformation capability and building the foundation for a corporate group that opens up the next era,' and it is working to optimize its business portfolio. In August 2025, it entered into a capital and business alliance agreement with Sumitomo Forestry Co., Ltd.
